# Status Page Count Tests — verify page count excludes managed files

# --- Fresh KB shows zero pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 0'

# --- Write one note, page count is 1 ---

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write status-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/status-note.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 1'

# --- Write one ADR, page count is 2 ---

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write status-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/status-decision.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 2'

# --- Delete note, page count drops to 1 ---

exec akb delete notes/status-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/status-note.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 1'

# --- Delete remaining ADR, page count drops to 0 ---

exec akb delete decisions/status-decision.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/decisions/status-decision.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 0'

# --- Index and log files are not counted as pages ---

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write final-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/final-note.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 1'

# index.md and log.md exist but are not counted
exists kb/index.md
exists kb/log.md

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Status Note
summary: Note for status testing
tags: test
---
Note content for status test.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Status Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for status testing
tags: [test]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-01-01'
---
## Context

Page counting must cover every page type. The status command reports the number of tracked pages, so a decision record is counted exactly like a note and a deleted page leaves the count immediately. See [[status-note]] for the note side of the same count.

## Decision

ADR content for status test. The decision lives under the decisions directory and counts toward the page total.

## Consequences

The decision counts toward the status page total. Deleting it drops the count by one.
